n1.speaker: sophie
n1.text: Hiya, are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?

translations.fa: سلام، آماده‌اید سفارش بدید، یا چند دقیقهٔ دیگه لازم دارید؟

branches.suggestion: We're ready. Could I have the roast beef, please?
Could we have a few more minutes, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه چند دقیقهٔ دیگه وقت بدید، لطفاً؟

n2.speaker: sophie
n2.text: No problem. Can I get you any drinks while you decide?

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. تا تصمیم بگیرید نوشیدنی بیارم؟

branches.suggestion: A jug of tap water, please.
An orange juice and a lemonade, please.
branches.suggestionFa: یه آب پرتقال و یه لیموناد، لطفاً.

cultureNote.en: Restaurants in the UK must give free tap water if you ask for it.

n3.speaker: sophie
n3.text: Lovely. Today's specials are lamb or nut roast. Everything comes with Yorkshire pudding.

translations.fa: عالیه. پیشنهاد امروز گوشت بره یا رست آجیلیه. همه چی با یورکشایر پودینگ میاد.

branches.suggestion: I'll have the roast chicken, please.

cultureNote.en: Sunday roast — meat, roast potatoes, veg, gravy and Yorkshire pudding — is a beloved British tradition.

n4.speaker: sophie
n4.text: It's a vegetarian loaf of nuts and veg. Very popular! Does anyone have any allergies I should know about?

translations.fa: یه قالب گیاهی از آجیل و سبزیه. خیلی محبوبه! کسی حساسیتی داره که باید بدونم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, my daughter is allergic to nuts.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، دخترم به آجیل حساسیت داره.

n5.speaker: sophie
n5.text: Noted. And for the little one — would she like the kids' menu? It comes with a pudding.

translations.fa: یادداشت شد. و برای کوچولو — منوی بچه‌ها می‌خواد؟ با یه دسر میاد.

branches.suggestion: No thanks, she'll share with me.
branches.suggestionFa: نه ممنون، با من شریک میشه.

cultureNote.en: In Britain, "pudding" often just means dessert.

n6.speaker: sophie
n6.text: Here we are. Careful, the plates are hot. Can I get you anything else?

translations.fa: بفرمایید. مراقب باشید، بشقاب‌ها داغن. چیز دیگه‌ای بیارم؟

branches.suggestion: Could we have some more gravy, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه یه کم سس بیشتر بیارید؟

n7.speaker: sophie
n7.text: Is everything alright with your meals?

branches.suggestion: The chicken is a bit cold, I'm afraid.

cultureNote.en: Staff often check "Is everything alright?" — it's fine to politely mention a problem.

n8.speaker: sophie
n8.text: Glad you're enjoying it. Can I tempt you with any desserts? Sticky toffee pudding is a favourite.

translations.fa: خوشحالم که لذت می‌برید. می‌تونم وسوسه‌تون کنم با دسر؟ پودینگ تافی خیلی محبوبه.

branches.suggestion: Go on then, sticky toffee pudding with custard!
branches.suggestionFa: باشه پس، پودینگ تافی با کاستارد!

branches.suggestion: Just the bill, please. We're full.

cultureNote.en: British "bill" = American "check". Tipping around 10–12.5% is common; check if service is included.

n9.speaker: sophie
n9.text: Perfect. I'll bring it over. Just give me a shout if you need anything.

translations.fa: عالیه. میارمش. اگه چیزی لازم داشتید صدام کنید.
